title: InventoryInstance
description: An SAP HANA Cloud instance as represented in the inventory service, providing a consolidated view of instance status and configuration.

serviceInstanceId.description: The unique identifier of the service instance.

servicePlanName.description: The name of the service plan (e.g., hana, hana-td, relational-data-lake).

instanceName.description: The display name of the instance.

provisioningState.description: The current provisioning state of the instance.

operationalState.description: The current operational state of the instance.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the instance was created.

modifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the instance was last modified.
